summary.tldr: Changes the Indian Act to create new registration rights in the Indian Register and add those people to Band Lists.
what_it_does: Creates new entitlements to registration in the Indian Register under the Indian Act.
Gives people who become entitled the right to have their names entered in a Band List kept by the Department of Indigenous Services.
Responds to a Charter challenge to parts of the Indian Act in Nicholas v. Canada (Attorney General).
summary.background: The bill was introduced after a Charter challenge to certain Indian Act provisions in Nicholas v. Canada (Attorney General).
